newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products steady to firmer.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products steady to firmer.

text.p: NWE oil products were steady to firmer on Friday, traders said.
Gasoline prices were firmer in line with crude and NYMEX unleaded futures. Trade house buying supported Eurograde barges with trade reported at $182.50 and $183 a tonne fob ARA.
Gas oil was slightly firmer in line with futures gains and slightly stronger premiums. Heating oil barges traded at July IPE +25 cents fob ARA.

High sulphur barges started off trading a shade softer with prompt done at $82, $82.25 and $82.50 and July at $83/$83.50. Late talk picked up to about $84 for sellers with demand said better than a day earlier.
High sulphur cargoes were steady, with one Russian cracked being talked two means plus $0.50/$1.
